parameters.title: Purpose and triggers
parameters.detail: The description says what the skill does and when to call it.

parameters.title: Pack, court and proceeding scope
parameters.detail: Packs: general. Courts: any. Proceedings: any.

parameters.title: Inputs
parameters.detail: The run needs: the cause of action; the parties and their addresses; the impugned order.

parameters.title: Required context
parameters.detail: The package includes: sources, lines, events, issues, authorities, rules.

parameters.title: Permitted tools
parameters.detail: 32 tool(s), all inside the jurisdiction role.

parameters.title: Output schema
parameters.detail: The output is a report; the gate checks its shape.

parameters.title: Anchors and provenance
parameters.detail: Every output item carries an anchor; the gate refuses an anchor of no record.

parameters.title: Approval points
parameters.detail: The skill proposes nothing that needs a write stop.

parameters.title: Tests
parameters.detail: Tests: civil-injunction; every item is anchored and nothing is decided.

parameters.title: Instructions
parameters.detail: The body states the steps, the anchors, not_read, the witness rule where it applies, and the line between a question and a decision.
